body: This will break if more LogicalOperators are added in future. Better filter these two operators at the beginning of the plugin.

> When the left side is a truthy/falsy value BUT the right side is <del>not</del> dropped, keep the left side and visit it with parser.walkExpression(expression.left) instead.

Right?
